title_zh: 公共验收护照风险台账

dimensions.label: 数据隐私
dimensions.note: 十二场景的数据类型、保存期和个人识别风险不同，真实系统尚未接入或运行。
dimensions.mitigation: 默认不识别个人、最小化保存、逐场景审计；越权采集立即停止并删除受影响数据。
dimensions.human_review: 数据保护、法务与公众代表在G2前逐场景复核。

dimensions.label: 实施复杂度
dimensions.note: 三区涉及河道、轨道、道路、消防、文保、权属和多运营主体，真实落位复杂。
dimensions.mitigation: 先普通基线和可撤原型，G0-G4逐门审查；任一专业条件不清即不落位。
dimensions.human_review: 规划、交通、市政、消防、文保、无障碍与权属专业团队共同签署G1结论。

dimensions.label: 公众接受度
dimensions.note: 当前没有居民同意或现场共同验收结果，合成案例不能代表真实接受度。
dimensions.mitigation: 保留no-AI普通服务，老人和残障者代表参与共验；每次开放限时且可申诉退出。
dimensions.human_review: 居民、老人、残障者代表与独立评估者参与G2-G4。

dimensions.label: 运维成本
dimensions.note: 持续人工值守、无障碍维护、审计和回滚演练会产生长期运维负担。
dimensions.mitigation: 首期限定L1/L2成本带，可逆组件跨场地复用，达到退出门槛即停止扩展。
dimensions.human_review: 运营与采购团队在试点前确认人员班次、维护责任和退出成本。

dimensions.label: 政策不确定性
dimensions.note: 生成式AI、数据、公共服务和场地审批适用边界需逐场景核对。
dimensions.mitigation: 标准矩阵限定法规适用范围；项目自设数字目标不得冒充法定义务。
dimensions.human_review: 法务、数据治理与法定专业部门在G1/G2复核适用性。

dimensions.label: 空间争议
dimensions.note: 当前边界和重点区是临时粗略polygon，可能与真实红线、权属或现状冲突。
dimensions.mitigation: 所有图面降级标注；official polygons到位后重算全部几何、指标、图册和落位。
dimensions.human_review: 官方数据持有者与注册规划专业人员共同确认后方可定位。

dimensions.label: 技术成熟度
dimensions.note: 24条合成路径只验证准入规则逻辑，没有现场安全、性能或可用性证据。
dimensions.mitigation: 保持field_performance为空；先离线人工演练，任何失控恢复普通no-AI基线。
dimensions.human_review: 独立安全评测、领域专家和当值安全员共同决定是否进入G3。

dimensions.label: 公平与包容性
dimensions.note: 数字入口、设备占道或不清晰交互可能排斥老人、残障者和无智能手机人群。
dimensions.mitigation: 3.0米概念净通道、人工双桌、纸质回执和无数字强制门槛作为红线。
dimensions.human_review: 无障碍顾问和不同能力用户通过现场共走与G2共验确认。

risk_register.risk_zh: 临时边界或概念空间被误读为官方红线、工程线位或获批方案
risk_register.risk_en: Provisional geometry or a conceptual spatial sequence is read as an official redline, engineering alignment, or approved scheme.
risk_register.stop_or_rollback: stop siting and all numerical spatial claims until official geometry and professional review are available

risk_register.risk_zh: 场景激活前用途、数据、责任人或开放时段未向公众说明
risk_register.risk_en: Purpose, data, accountable owner, or operating hours are not disclosed before activation.
risk_register.stop_or_rollback: do not open; restore the ordinary no-AI route and publish the failed passport field

risk_register.risk_zh: 高影响输出越过具名专业人员作出最终决定
risk_register.risk_en: A high-impact output bypasses the named qualified human who must make the final decision.
risk_register.stop_or_rollback: immediate stop, invalidate affected output, hand over to a qualified human, and open an incident review

risk_register.risk_zh: 基本服务以手机、账户、人脸或全数字通道作为强制门槛
risk_register.risk_en: A phone, account, face, or digital-only channel becomes mandatory for basic access.
risk_register.stop_or_rollback: disable the digital gate and restore staffed or physical equivalent access before reopening

risk_register.risk_zh: 无障碍路径、盲道、休息点或人工服务被设备和活动挤占
risk_register.risk_en: Equipment or events obstruct the step-free route, tactile guidance, rest points, or staffed service.
risk_register.stop_or_rollback: pause the affected zone, remove obstructions, restore the route, and repeat co-acceptance before reopening

risk_register.risk_zh: 测试与公众流线、后勤或水系和铁路等待核验约束发生冲突
risk_register.risk_en: Testing conflicts with public circulation, logistics, or pending water, rail, fire, heritage, or ownership constraints.
risk_register.stop_or_rollback: do not run live equipment; return to no-AI public use and relocate only after professional clearance

risk_register.risk_zh: 开源成果的版权、来源、事实或撤回通道不完整
risk_register.risk_en: Open outputs lack complete rights, provenance, factual review, or a withdrawal route.
risk_register.stop_or_rollback: withhold or withdraw the output, preserve the correction trail, and notify affected contributors

risk_register.risk_zh: 上诉、纠错、删除、急停或退出只停留在文字中而无法演练
risk_register.risk_en: Appeal, correction, deletion, emergency stop, or exit exists only on paper and cannot be rehearsed.
risk_register.stop_or_rollback: freeze deployment, execute the no-AI fallback, publish the failure, and require an independent retest

risk_register.risk_zh: 合成概念图被误认为现场照片、居民意见或工程可行性证据
risk_register.risk_en: Synthetic concept imagery is mistaken for a site photograph, resident consent, or engineering feasibility evidence.
risk_register.stop_or_rollback: remove the misleading display until the conceptual status and rights record are restored
